bank: EYES AND EARS -- THE OBJECTIVE TELLS OF PIXEL ART, AND WHO HOLDS EACH ONE
note: DRAFT MATERIAL, NEVER WIRED INTO THE GAME. The craft canon's list of things that can be judged WITHOUT taste, each marked with whether a machine in this repo already holds it, whether this lane added it today, or whether nobody holds it yet. REUSE CHECK: gates/pixel_craft_gate.py already holds six of these through tools/bohemia_pixel_craft_audit.py. Nothing here re-measures those six.
not_a_taste_machine: None of these say whether art looks good. They say whether it was BUILT like pixel art. The gestalt is Paolo's, forever (amendment B).

tells.what_it_looks_like: single pixels alone in a field, noise instead of shape
a palette of one-offs: a shrunk painting, not a set of decisions
two pixel sizes in one scene
light coming from everywhere: a shape shaded evenly inward from its own outline

tells.tell: the light argues with the scene
tells.what_it_looks_like: one tile lit from the left in a world lit from the upper left
tells.holder: pixel_craft_gate (light agreement, by PAIRS after the 7/28 amendment)

tells.what_it_looks_like: texture made of random dots rather than a few shapes repeated
two colour bands running parallel for their whole length, so the eye reads a contour line the artist never drew
tells.how: the gaps between consecutive colour boundaries in a row, compared row to row: a band is a median gap that holds within one pixel for six rows or more, with the surrounding ground excluded
tells.validated: a deliberately banded ramp reads 31.2%, the same ramp with hand-broken edges 21.9%, noise 0.0%, a two-tone shape 0.0%, a noisy subject on black 0.0%

tells.what_it_looks_like: a line whose steps are irregular -- 1,3,1,2 instead of 2,2,2 -- or a one-pixel nick between two long runs
tells.how: run lengths along the drawn silhouette; a step that agrees with neither neighbour is a jaggy
tells.limit: IT ONLY WORKS ON A SILHOUETTE. A full-bleed tile has no outline, so 13 of our 16 art banks return nothing. Reported as '-' rather than as zero, because a checker that reports a clean zero for a thing it cannot see is the worst kind

tells.tell: anti-aliasing where it does not belong
tells.what_it_looks_like: soft blended pixels on art meant to be crisp, or AA against a background it will never sit on
tells.how: count colours that appear only on boundaries between two other colours and nowhere else; that is what an AA pixel is

tells.what_it_looks_like: a checkerboard of two colours standing in for a colour that should have been mixed
tells.how: a 2x2 alternating pattern repeated over an area, which is a small autocorrelation test

tells.what_it_looks_like: a one-pixel line of the wrong colour where two tiles meet
tells.holder: the craft audit measures an offset seam per tile; the CORPUS-WIDE version is open

tells.what_it_looks_like: an outline that is two pixels thick in one place and one in another for no reason

tells.tell: detail level does not match across the set
tells.what_it_looks_like: one tile busier than its neighbours, so the eye is pulled to the wrong thing
tells.note: the mastery law M5 states it; no machine holds it. Cluster density per bank is the nearest existing number

tells.tell: contrast spent on the wrong thing
tells.what_it_looks_like: the loudest thing on screen is a wall, not a person
tells.note: mastery law M3. A machine can rank contrast; only a person says which should have won

tells.tell: hue does not shift with light
tells.what_it_looks_like: shadows that are the same hue as the light, just darker
tells.how: hue difference between the lightest and darkest cluster of one material; mastery law M6 says it should shift, not just dim

coverage_finding: The craft machine reads 84 of the 1,465 pieces of art in banks/, in 2 of the 17 banks that hold base64 art. That is 5.7%. Nothing is wrong with the six measures; they are simply pointed at one tileset.

measured_9_5.reading: The hair and face sheets are the most banded art in the repo by a wide margin, and the tile banks read zero because a grimy texture has no parallel bands to find. This agrees with what this lane saw by eye on 9/5: the player's hair from behind is a flat mass with one straight mark on it.
